question: after a one-hidden-layer MLP learns a structured task, how many additional BLINDED random associations can it fit before crossing a FROZEN original-task retention margin, conditional on the checkpoint — and is that endpoint predictable from parameter count or compressed length alone (H2 of the M3-M6 draft)
endpoint_semantics: a conditional empirical intervention result under this exact protocol; NEVER 'unused bits', 'remaining intelligence' or exact Kolmogorov complexity

task_families.generator_identity_rule: generator id = sha256(master|family|regime|role|instance); DEVELOPMENT, CALIBRATION and CONFIRMATION roles use DISJOINT instance ranges (0-15, 16-23, 24-31) and never share a generator id

architectures.output: linear regression head / sigmoid for boolean tasks

optimizer_capability_controls.rule: before any capacity claim, the SAME optimizer budget must first learn each structured family to its frozen learnability criterion on a clean development instance; a family that fails is typed OPTIMIZATION_LIMITED and its cells never become capacity evidence
optimizer_capability_controls.learnability_criterion: task metric within the family's frozen threshold on held-out rows of the SAME generator

retention.metric: original-task evaluation loss on held-out rows of the training generator
retention.margin_rule: frozen at intervention start: retention violated when loss exceeds (1 + 0.10) * checkpoint loss on two consecutive evaluations

association_batches.blinding: random input/label associations drawn from the sealed seed stream; batch contents never inspected before commitment
association_batches.acquisition_criterion: batch fitted when its association error falls below the frozen threshold within the update budget
association_batches.stop_rule: first confirmed retention violation OR first acquisition failure; the endpoint batch index is the result

controls.random_initialization: an untrained matched-architecture model runs the identical intervention with matched compute
controls.matched_compute: control updates equal treatment updates within 1%

statistics.unit: the task GENERATOR (never a checkpoint, seed or adjacent temporal sample)
statistics.nested_seeds: 3 model seeds nested per generator; reported as nested repetitions
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni over the frozen confirmatory contrast family; family list frozen before any confirmation outcome
statistics.missing_runs: typed states remain in the denominator; never silently dropped

measurements.cost_rule: every measurement's CPU cost is recorded per checkpoint and stays in the cost denominator
